name: codex
description: Hand a one-off task to the OpenAI Codex CLI for a cross-model second opinion — review-codex runs one read-only P0/P1 code review with evidence plus a fresh-session recheck, ask-codex answers a free-form question, delegate-codex lets Codex edit the working tree. Every call routes through one bridge; ask and delegate report and stop when Codex is unavailable, while review falls back once to a fresh read-only Claude subagent. Codex output is surfaced verbatim as untrusted external text. Assumes an OpenAI-authenticated Codex setup.
